arguments.body: Hi Nessa, your landlord says the landing smoke alarm work was done on 31 August, and that he also tightened/secured some sockets and gave you a dehumidifier for the bathroom. We haven't confirmed this yet, so could you tell us: 1) Is a working smoke alarm now fitted on the landing, and has the ceiling hole gone? 2) Are any sockets still loose or coming away from the wall (any scorching, buzzing or warm sockets, please stop using them and tell us at once)? 3) Did you receive the dehumidifier, and is there any damp or mould in the bathroom? If there is no working alarm at the moment, please tell us today. We will review this with you by 10 September.

Dear Mr Rusk, thank you for the update. We have noted it, but we cannot mark the job complete until we have confirmation from the tenant, so we're checking with her. Please could you reply by 10 September with: who fitted the new smoke alarm and its type (mains/battery, and that it is tested and working), and whether a qualified electrician checked the loose sockets (including the kitchen socket after the February boiler work) - an electrical installation report or certificate would help. Also, the dehumidifier suggests damp in the bathroom; please tell us what you know so we can log it. If you'd prefer us to arrange any of this, let us know.
